name: sage-garden-organza-qipao-girl
image_purpose: Create a vertical social fashion portrait blending modern styling with a traditional Chinese garden setting.

prompt.project_info: UGC soft-elegant outdoor-nature Chinese garden fashion portrait.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult East Asian woman with a gentle warm smile and direct eye contact. She has very long straight deep-black hair in two loose braids with side-swept bangs and wears natural glossy lips, soft rosy blush, subtle eyeliner and natural-looking lashes. Preserve the approved adult face reference if supplied; do not use a celebrity likeness.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 2:3 or 3:4 portrait. The subject stands relaxed with a slight turn, right hand on hip and left hand relaxed or lightly touching the skirt. She wears a sage-green organza qipao-style jacket with wide lantern sleeves, mandarin collar, panda and bamboo embroidery, translucent petal shoulder overlays and gold frog buttons; a short dark-green satin skirt with subtle floral embroidery; a small black silk tassel pouch at the waist, thin gold necklace and minimalist earrings. Set her in a traditional Suzhou- or Hangzhou-style Chinese garden with wooden pavilions, curved bridges, koi pond with lotus leaves, willow trees, bamboo, foliage, stone paths and distant tiled roofs.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural golden-hour daylight, dappled leaf shadows, gentle rim light on hair and shoulders, soft highlights on organza, warm skin tones and pastel sage-green garden atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Canon EOS R5 look, 85mm prime lens, f/1.8, shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh, strong subject isolation, ultra-photorealistic 8K detail, realistic organza translucency, embroidery and satin sheen.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: An ultra-photorealistic vertical 2:3 or 3:4 fashion portrait of one approved adult East Asian woman with a gentle warm smile and direct eye contact, very long straight deep-black hair in two loose braids, soft side-swept bangs, natural glossy lips, rosy blush, subtle eyeliner and natural lashes. She stands relaxed with a slight turn, right hand on hip and left hand lightly touching her skirt. She wears a sage-green organza qipao-style jacket with wide lantern sleeves, mandarin collar, panda and bamboo embroidery, translucent petal shoulder overlays and gold frog buttons, paired with a short dark-green satin skirt with subtle floral embroidery, a black silk tassel pouch, thin gold necklace and minimalist earrings. Place her in a serene traditional Chinese garden with wooden pavilions, curved bridges, koi pond, lotus leaves, willow trees, bamboo, lush foliage, stone paths and distant tiled roofs. Soft golden-hour daylight, dappled leaf shadows, gentle rim light, soft highlights on organza, warm skin tones, pastel green environment, Canon EOS R5 look, 85mm prime lens, f/1.8 creamy bokeh, strong subject isolation, realistic fabric detail and 8K photorealism.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, real-person likeness without approved reference, celebrity resemblance, wardrobe malfunction, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, over-saturated, HDR look, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, watermark, text, logo
